keyFindings.description: mutation.go:720 dedupes places by Place() text, so a quote left in two separate code blocks is named 'a code block … move that text out of it'. That contradicts the 'one pass over the markdown resolves it' claim in the reanchorError doc and in AGENTS.md:79-80. Count per place ('two code blocks'), fix the placeList example (a heading never refuses), and update the test 'one place its quote stands in twice'.

No test tells nearest order from document order: in the two-place case the front matter is both nearest and first. Add a case with the anchor late and a code block nearer than the front matter, expecting 'a code block and the front matter'.
find_test.go:1019 checks errors.Is(err, ErrTargetNotFound), which a full *ErrQuoteNotFound also passes; assert err == ErrTargetNotFound so the cheap miss stays pinned.
Find (find.go:160-161) is now a pass-through to find, its only caller; move the body into Find.
mutation.go:649-664 re-tests `refused` after the loop to learn why it stopped; decide each outcome in the loop (labelled continue on the reanchors loop), leaving only the all-refused return after it.
Cited find.go:111 and :1040, both stale. Fixed by the reviewer (prose only): it now names the symbols. PR body 'Look at first' named refusedReanchor; fixed by the reviewer to reanchorError.
